plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: (1) An instrument that checks each case's category against the requester's rule (C3); none exists in the library, so C3 is uncovered. (2) A check of the live tables after the promotion against the staged set (C1, C2, C4): the library's instruments read only the staged set, so the live link rests on the promotion's line alone. (3) A check of all 100 account reads for scope (C5) and of all 100 sending calls against the outbox (C10). Scope of call and trace of call are available only on named lines at 10 each, and not in the plan. Covering all 100 reads and 100 sends would cost 2000, and the whole session allowance is 50, so at most about five lines can be paid for. C10 can therefore only be checked after the sends, and only sample-wise, unless the worker's ordered-not-confirmed sends are traced at A3, which I would ask for within the allowance. (4) Summary of the change at A2 was left out to stay within the price: it would confirm only that the kept staged set has not changed since A1, a check I judged not needed against the cost. The plan totals 180 of the 200 allowed.
